name: shortsintel
description: Short-form video and ad intelligence for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook: research what works in a niche, track creators, hashtags, sounds and advertisers, and search the Meta and TikTok ad libraries.

interface.longDescription:
ShortsIntel analyses public short-form video and ad data on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook, and gives you its own findings: ranked videos, outlier creators, verbatim hooks, winning formats, audience gaps and recommended angles.

Use it to:
- Research what is working in a niche and get a readable summary of themes, hooks and angles.
- Look up a video, creator, hashtag or sound, and score a video against its creator's usual reach.
- Track creators, hashtags, sounds and Meta advertisers daily, group them into Collections, and read what changed.
- Search the Meta Ad Library and the TikTok ad library, with a winner score on each Meta ad.

Built for creative strategists, marketers, agencies and creators planning short-form content and ads.

You sign in to your ShortsIntel account through OAuth. ShortsIntel covers public posts and public ad library entries only: it cannot see private accounts, direct messages or data behind a login.
defaultPrompt: What hooks are working for AI video tools on TikTok this week?
Track Nike's TikTok account and tell me what changed since yesterday.
Show me Meta ads running for protein powder in the US.

positive.description: Research what is working in a short-form video niche
positive.prompt: What hooks are working for AI video tools on TikTok this week?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant states the Research cost in Credits, starts the Research, and polls get_run until it completes (usually 1-3 minutes). It then summarises the Digest: the main themes, verbatim hooks that are working with example videos, winning formats, audience gaps from comments and recommended angles, citing ranked TikTok videos with their view counts and links.

positive.description: Look up a creator and how their recent videos perform
positive.prompt: Look up NASA's TikTok account and tell me which of its recent videos are outperforming.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant states the lookup cost in Credits, then calls get_creator with platform tiktok and handle nasa. It reports the profile (followers, total likes, video count) and the recent videos, naming those whose views are well above the account's usual reach, with view counts, publish dates and links.

positive.description: Report what changed on tracked creators, hashtags and sounds
positive.prompt: What has changed on the accounts and hashtags I'm tracking this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Both calls are free. The assistant lists the account's Trackers (NASA on TikTok and Instagram, the #nasa hashtag, a TikTok sound and the Nike advertiser) with their state, then reads the Change Reports since the start of the week and summarises them per Tracker: new videos or ads, outlier videos, follower moves and velocity spikes. Trackers with nothing notable are reported as having no changes.

positive.description: Search the Meta Ad Library for a product category in a country
positive.prompt: Show me Meta ads running for protein powder in the US.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant states the search cost in Credits, then calls search_ads with library meta, query "protein powder" and country US. It lists the active ads with advertiser name, ad copy, start date, platforms and a link to each ad, and points out the likely winners using each ad's winner score (long-running ads with many variants).

positive.description: Manage a Collection of Trackers in bulk
positive.prompt: Pause every Tracker in my "Review creators" collection.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds the "Review creators" Collection, asks for approval because this changes the account, then calls act_on_collection with action pause. It confirms which member Trackers are now paused (the NASA creator Trackers), notes that pausing is free and that paused Trackers are not charged, and lists any member that also sits in another Collection. Asking "resume them" afterwards calls act_on_collection with action resume.

negative.description: Publishing or posting content to a social account (ShortsIntel only reads public data; it cannot post)
negative.prompt: Post this video to my TikTok account with the caption "New drop this Friday".

negative.description: General video-editing how-to that needs no platform data
negative.prompt: How do I add auto-captions to a short video in CapCut?

negative.description: Private account data such as DMs or a creator's private analytics (ShortsIntel covers public posts and public ad libraries only)
negative.prompt: Show me the DMs and private Instagram Insights for the account @nasa.
